description: Record-precise Machine Snapshot. Telemetry panels show only ldi_data; alarm panels show only ldi_alarm_log joined to the verified master. Alarm-only machines are explicitly labeled rather than receiving invented telemetry values.

panels.description: The table keeps every telemetry record from the selected machine and minute. Clicking a blue Timestamp changes only the exact-record detail panels below; it does not collapse this table to one row.

value.title: Update detail panels and keep all records in this minute

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "time" AS "Timestamp", eqp_id AS "Machine", state AS "State", mo AS "MO", fpn AS "FPN", layer_name AS "Layer", (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) AS "Board", filmno AS "Film", resist AS "Resist", scale_mode AS "Scale Mode", factory AS "Factory", log_id AS "Log ID"
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
  AND "time" >= time_bucket('${time_group:raw}'::INTERVAL, to_timestamp(COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0')::NUMERIC / 1000.0))
  AND "time" < time_bucket('${time_group:raw}'::INTERVAL, to_timestamp(COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0')::NUMERIC / 1000.0)) + '${time_group:raw}'::INTERVAL
ORDER BY "time" ASC

SELECT
  ROUND(total_time :: NUMERIC, 2) AS value
FROM
  public.ldi_data
WHERE
  eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
ORDER BY
  ABS(
    EXTRACT(
      EPOCH
      FROM
        (
          "time" - to_timestamp(
            COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0') :: NUMERIC / 1000.0
          )
        )
    )
  ),
  "time" DESC
LIMIT
  1

panels.description: Real PE values from the selected event. N/A means this machine/event did not provide PE data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(pe_1::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_1",ROUND(pe_2::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_2",
 ROUND(pe_3::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_3",ROUND(pe_4::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_4",
 ROUND(pe_5::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_5",ROUND(pe_6::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_6",
 ROUND(max_pe::NUMERIC,3) AS "MAX|PE|",ROUND(pe_setting::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_setting",
 CASE WHEN max_pe IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN max_pe <= pe_setting THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'OUT OF SPEC' END AS "PE Status"
FROM (
 SELECT d.*,GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) AS max_pe
 FROM public.ldi_data d WHERE eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
 ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("time" - to_timestamp(COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0')::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), "time" DESC
 LIMIT 1
) event_row;

panels.description: Real JE values from the selected event with PASS/OUT OF SPEC evaluated against je_setting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(je_1::NUMERIC,3) AS "je_1",ROUND(je_2::NUMERIC,3) AS "je_2",
 ROUND(je_3::NUMERIC,3) AS "je_3",ROUND(je_4::NUMERIC,3) AS "je_4",
 ROUND(max_je::NUMERIC,3) AS "MAX|JE|",ROUND(je_setting::NUMERIC,3) AS "je_setting",
 CASE WHEN max_je IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN max_je <= je_setting THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'OUT OF SPEC' END AS "JE Status"
FROM (
 SELECT d.*,GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) AS max_je
 FROM public.ldi_data d WHERE eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
 ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("time" - to_timestamp(COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0')::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), "time" DESC
 LIMIT 1
) event_row;

panels.title: je_1–je_4 + je_setting

panels.description: Process capability from v_machine_spc_ranking. Cpk >= 1.33 = Capable, Sigma Level = Cpk * 3.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_machines AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE eqp_id=split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring},' - ',1)
), pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id,d.pe_setting,p.pe FROM public.ldi_data d JOIN selected_machines sm ON sm.eqp_id=d.eqp_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time") AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id,COUNT(*) sample_count,AVG(pe) mean_pe,STDDEV_SAMP(pe) stddev_pe,AVG(pe_setting) lim FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
)
SELECT sm.eqp_id AS "Machine",COALESCE(stats.sample_count,0) AS "Samples",ROUND(stats.mean_pe::NUMERIC,2) AS "Mean PE",
 ROUND((lim/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0))::NUMERIC,2) AS "Cp",
 ROUND(LEAST((lim-mean_pe)/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0),(mean_pe+lim)/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0))::NUMERIC,2) AS "Cpk"
FROM selected_machines sm LEFT JOIN stats ON stats.eqp_id=sm.eqp_id;

panels.description: Alarm rows within ±5 minutes of the exact selected telemetry record. This panel stays empty until a Timestamp is selected in STEP 1.

targets.rawSql:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0')::NUMERIC / 1000.0) AS "time"
),
all_machines AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.factory::TEXT AS factory, d.process::TEXT AS process
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.equipmentid, a.factory::TEXT, a.process::TEXT
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
  WHERE a.equipmentid IS NOT NULL
),
selected_machines AS (
  SELECT
    am.eqp_id,
    MIN(am.factory) AS factory,
    MIN(am.process) AS process
  FROM all_machines am
  WHERE am.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
  GROUP BY am.eqp_id
),
alarm_rows AS (
  SELECT
    al.logid, al.logdate, al.errorcode, al.errortime, al.equipmentid, al.factory, al.process,
    COALESCE(m.alarm_id, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_id,
    COALESCE(m.alarm_type, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_type,
    COALESCE(m.alarm_code, al.errorcode::TEXT) AS alarm_code,
    COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, al.errorcode::TEXT) AS alarm_msg,
    CASE WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'No master record' ELSE COALESCE(m.alarm_detail, 'No detail') END AS alarm_detail,
    CASE WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MAPPED' END AS mapping_status
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log al
  JOIN selected_machines sm ON sm.eqp_id = al.equipmentid
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON al.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
  WHERE al.logdate BETWEEN (SELECT "time" - INTERVAL '5 minutes' FROM target) AND (SELECT "time" + INTERVAL '5 minutes' FROM target)
)
SELECT * FROM alarm_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'NO-ALARM-' || sm.eqp_id, target."time", NULL::TEXT, NULL::TEXT, sm.eqp_id, sm.factory, sm.process,
  'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NO ALARM', 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'No alarm event within ±5 minutes',
  'Telemetry exists at the selected point, but no alarm event exists for this machine in the ±5-minute window', 'NO ALARM'
FROM selected_machines sm CROSS JOIN target
WHERE target."time" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alarm_rows ar WHERE ar.equipmentid = sm.eqp_id)
ORDER BY logdate DESC, equipmentid;

panels.title: Alarm Context ±5 min — ldi_alarm_log + Master

panels.description: All telemetry and alarm events in the selected ±5-minute context. No SQL row limit is applied; pagination controls rendering.

targets.rawSql:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(COALESCE(NULLIF('${event_time_ms:raw}', ''), '0')::NUMERIC / 1000.0) AS t
),
events AS (
  SELECT
    d."time" AS event_time, d.eqp_id AS machine, 'STATE'::TEXT AS event_type, 'ldi_data'::TEXT AS source,
    d.log_id::TEXT AS logid, NULL::TEXT AS errorcode, NULL::TEXT AS errortime, d.factory::TEXT AS factory, d.process::TEXT AS process,
    'NOT APPLICABLE'::TEXT AS alarm_id, 'TELEMETRY'::TEXT AS alarm_type, 'NOT APPLICABLE'::TEXT AS alarm_code,
    'State sample; no alarm event'::TEXT AS alarm_msg, 'Alarm fields apply only to ALARM rows'::TEXT AS alarm_detail,
    'NOT APPLICABLE'::TEXT AS mapping_status, CASE WHEN d.state THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'DOWN' END AS description
  FROM public.ldi_data d CROSS JOIN target
  WHERE d.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    AND d."time" BETWEEN target.t - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND target.t + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    a.logdate, a.equipmentid, 'ALARM', 'ldi_alarm_log', a.logid, a.errorcode::TEXT, a.errortime::TEXT,
    a.factory::TEXT, a.process::TEXT, COALESCE(m.alarm_id, 'UNMAPPED'), COALESCE(m.alarm_type, 'UNMAPPED'),
    COALESCE(m.alarm_code, a.errorcode::TEXT), COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode::TEXT),
    CASE WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'No master record' ELSE COALESCE(m.alarm_detail, 'No detail') END,
    CASE WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MAPPED' END, COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode::TEXT)
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT CROSS JOIN target
  WHERE a.equipmentid = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    AND a.logdate BETWEEN target.t - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND target.t + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
)
SELECT event_time AS "Event Time", machine AS "Machine", event_type AS "Event Type", source AS "Source", description AS "Description",
  mapping_status, logid, errorcode, errortime, factory, process, alarm_id, alarm_type, alarm_code, alarm_msg, alarm_detail
FROM events ORDER BY event_time DESC;
